critical_code_review_comments: AppDetail.jsx is 446 lines and is fine, but PayAppLarge/FieldLarge/CollabLarge/ChapterVisual could be moved into /components/appdetail/* if the file grows further.
SoonDetail notify form is client-only (MOCKED, no backend). Emails are discarded — expected per PRD but worth noting in landing copy.
Email validation is `email.includes('@')` only — the required HTML5 type='email' does the heavier lift, but consider a stricter regex if this ever wires to a backend.
